items.label: section_header
items.text: DENSITY

items.label: text
items.text: Solids,liquids and gaseshave different properties and characteristics.One such characteristicis density.Solidsare oftenvery dense-thatis,theyhave a high mass for a certain volume.Liquids are often less dense than solids,and gases have very low densities.
